subject: youtube.language_expansion.strategy
summary: Recovered media strategy used multilingual market research and planned language expansion after proving the Arabic format: build one media asset/production system, then create English versions of winning episodes rather than operate multiple independent production systems from day one.

details.expansion_rule: localize winning episodes after proof, with English explicitly named in the recovered artifacts
details.operating_model: one media asset / one production system rather than separate production systems per language
details.unresolved_architecture: The recovered artifacts do not yet explicitly settle whether multilingual expansion should use one YouTube channel with multiple audio tracks or separate localized channels; this must be re-decided using current YouTube multilingual features and market evidence before launch.
